{

        "creative"

      "needs_tools": []

    {
      "id": "s3",
      "agent_id": "creative",
      "description": "Write the final markdown report on solar panel efficiency based on the research and the agreed angle from the standup.",
      "dependencies": [
        "s1",
        "s2"
      ],
      "produces": "solar_efficiency_report.md",
      "consumes": [
        "solar_research.md",
        "meeting_decision.md"
